API reference

Versioned, read-only, no key needed. The interactive reference is at /api/docs and the OpenAPI document at /api/docs/json.

Conventions

  • Durations and session times are whole nanoseconds, in fields ending _ns.
  • Session time counts from the start of the session’s data stream, which usually begins about an hour before the session. Telemetry, laps, race control and radio all share it. A session’s stream_start_utc gives its UTC time; it is derived from team radio timestamps.
  • Clock times are ISO 8601 in UTC, in fields ending _utc.
  • A missing value is null. Zero is a measured zero.
  • Speed is km/h, throttle is a percentage, temperatures are °C, pressure is mbar and wind is m/s. Car positions are in F1’s own track coordinates.
  • Anything F1Archive computes rather than reads from the source, such as lap distance, is marked as derived.
  • Telemetry is stored as the source has it. Car data and position data share one timeline; each row is a new sample of one of them, with the other’s last values repeated.

Identifiers

A season is its year. Events and sessions are named from their official names: 2021/abu-dhabi/race, 2023/qatar/sprint-shootout, 2026/pre-season-testing-2/day-1. A session key such as 2021-abu-dhabi-race joins the files of an export. These stay the same when the database is rebuilt. Drivers are identified by car number within a session and by the Jolpica id (max_verstappen) across sessions.

Telemetry windows

Telemetry is requested by time window. A response holds one array per channel:

curl 'https://f1archive.org/api/v1/sessions/2021/abu-dhabi/race/telemetry?drivers=33,44&from_ns=9070000000000&to_ns=9160000000000&channels=speed,throttle,brake' { "session": "2021-abu-dhabi-race", "from_ns": 9070000000000, "to_ns": 9160000000000, "channels": ["speed", "throttle", "brake"], "drivers": { "33": { "ts_ns": [...], "speed": [...], "throttle": [...], "brake": [...] }, "44": { ... } }, "truncated": false, "next_from_ns": 9160000000001 }

Follow next_from_ns to read a whole session. For one lap, use /laps/33/58/telemetry.

Known gaps

Wherever data is missing on the site, a link explains that particular case. Missing values are never estimated or filled in.
GapExplanationSource
Only the race was published for the 2018 Bahrain Grand PrixF1 moved its timing archive to the current format in early 2018. For the Bahrain weekend only the race was written to the new archive; Practice 1, 2, 3 and Qualifying were never published there. The sessions still appear in the official schedule, which is why they are listed here.research into F1's archive
2018 Chinese Grand Prix Practice 3 was never archivedF1 never wrote this session to its archive during the same early-2018 changeover that affected Bahrain.research into F1's archive
This session never took placeSaturday running at Suzuka in 2019, including Practice 3, was cancelled because of Typhoon Hagibis. There is nothing to archive.archive records
F1's archive failed to record this sessionThe archive failed to record 2021 Emilia Romagna Practice 1. Live timing was also down during the broadcast of the session.research into F1's archive
Not an official sessionThe "High Speed Track Test" before the first Jeddah race was an internal systems check, not an official session. Its archive entry points at F1's internal test environment, so there is no public data.archive records
F1's archive has no telemetry for this sessionF1's archive has neither car data nor position data for any driver in this session. Laps, results and the other feeds for the session are present.archive records
F1's archive has no telemetry for this driver in this sessionFor a handful of driver-sessions F1's archive has neither car data nor position data. This is one of them. The driver's laps and results are still available.archive records
Position data was not published for this sessionF1's archive has only the car-data feed (speed, RPM, gear, throttle, brake, DRS) for this session. The position feed (x, y, z) was never published, so cars cannot be placed on the circuit map.archive records
Car data was not published for this sessionF1's archive has only the position feed (x, y, z) for this session. Speed, RPM, gear, throttle, brake and DRS were never published, so there are no telemetry traces, only positions on the map.archive records
No circuit data yet for the Madrid circuitCircuit corners and marshal positions come from MultiViewer, which has no data for the new Madrid circuit yet. They fill in on a later sync once MultiViewer publishes them.archive records
No circuit data for SepangThe 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix was held at Sepang (Kuala Lumpur). MultiViewer, the source of corner and marshal data, has no data for Sepang in any year.archive records
No circuit data for the Sakhir outer layoutMultiViewer returned an empty list for the outer layout used at the 2020 Sakhir Grand Prix.archive records
No pit stops: the race was run behind the Safety CarThe 2021 Belgian Grand Prix ran a couple of laps behind the Safety Car in heavy rain and was then stopped. No pit stops were recorded.archive records
The championship prediction feed did not exist yetF1 started publishing the live championship prediction feed in mid-2019. There is none for 2018, 2019 rounds 1-6, or the 2023 season opener.archive records
Session cancelled for weatherNo running took place in this session because of the weather, so there are no laps or best times.archive records
No weather data for the 2022 pre-season testF1 did not publish a weather feed for the 2022 pre-season test.archive records
Testing has no championship standingsPre-season testing does not count towards the championship, so there are no standings after it.archive records

Data copied from elsewhere

  • For 2018 Austrian and German GP Qualifying F1's top-three feed was missing, so the final top three was taken from the results. Those rows have no timestamp or lap state.
  • F1's 2018 index omits the Australian GP, so its circuit data was copied from 2019. The layout did not change.
  • F1's 2024 index omits rounds 1-9 (Bahrain to Canada), so their circuit data was copied from 2023 (China and Emilia Romagna from 2025). Layouts were the same across 2023-2025.

States

available
Real rows exist.
partly available
Telemetry only: either the car feed or the position feed was not published.
nothing published
The source answered with nothing. Either the feed does not apply to that kind of session or F1 never published it; the two cannot be told apart.
not in the archive
There is no record at all. The request failed or the session was never archived. Every full sync tries again.
not imported here
The archive has it, but this copy of the site was built without it.
